remarks: Welcome to Mill Bridge, a highly sought-after complex in desirable mid-city Stamford. Nestled among brick walkways and park-like grounds along the Rippowam River, this community blends city convenience with a country living feel. This rare mid-city gem offers 2 bedrooms and 2 full baths, freshly painted with brand new floors and Kohler faucets throughout. The spacious living room features a wood-burning fireplace and a slider leading to the balcony, where you'll enjoy scenic views of the river. The primary suite boasts a walk-in closet and ensuite bath. A full-size washer and dryer in the unit adds convenience, while a carport directly under the unit plus visitor parking makes life even easier. Recent updates include a freshly painted exterior and a newer roof. Relax outside at the picnic table or Adirondack chairs, or enjoy an easy stroll to Scalzi Park, downtown restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and Metro North. Highways, hospitals, and public transportation are just minutes away, making this location perfect for commuters. With its unbeatable location, walkability, and welcoming atmosphere, this turn-key condo is a gem.
